decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program costs little to maintain alongside existing production, and its value is still uncertain after only one year, but it may be merged into the broader express offering.
The 72-hour delivery promise ties up stock and logistics capacity, but one year of results is too little to judge its value, so the option stays open while demand is observed.
The fire-resistant exterior door is a European-certified extension of the established Teckentrup 62 modular system, so it costs little to keep and fits core demand.
The door and gate express program has its own dedicated page, which signals a stronger commitment, and it remains a cheap option to keep while customer uptake becomes clearer.
Most of the cost of the online ordering platform is already sunk, the trend toward digitalization makes its long-term value likely, and keeping it preserves options for later expansion.
Fire and smoke protection doors are regulation-driven core products with stable demand and low incremental cost, so there is no reason to abandon them.
